[[File:Regal_Visor.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Atton Rand]] wearing a regal visor]]
A '''regal visor''' was a band designed to increase the attractiveness of the wearer. It also included a voice enhancement module that regulated tone and volume of speech. This headgear was primarily used in diplomatic situations where the slightest error could offend.
